entries.claim: AC1: git grep Coda-Health/ shows only the kept external repo/submodule references and zero coda-rust legacy IDs in infra/gcp
AC3a: offline tofu fmt -check and tofu test across rust-environments (61), public-site (31), and observability (77)
command: set -euo pipefail; tofu fmt -check -recursive infra/gcp; for d in infra/gcp/rust-environments infra/gcp/public-site infra/gcp/observability; do (cd "$d" && tofu init -backend=false -input=false -lockfile=readonly >/dev/null && tofu test); done

entries.claim: AC3b: rust-environments Python contract tests (19/19) and public-site admin bootstrap --print WIF condition/subject
command: set -euo pipefail; python3 -m unittest discover -s infra/gcp/rust-environments/tests -p "*.py" -v; bash infra/gcp/public-site/scripts/production-admin-bootstrap.sh --print; bash infra/gcp/public-site/scripts/staging-admin-bootstrap.sh --print
